metrics.description: How many people reacted to your post. Includes Like, Love, Care, Haha, Wow, Sad, and Angry.
metrics.name: Reactions

metrics.description: The number of comments your post received. Shows when your post is starting conversations, not just getting seen.
metrics.name: Comments

metrics.description: The percentage of people who interacted with your post compared to how many saw it. Balances views and actions to show how compelling your posts are.
metrics.name: Eng. Rate

metrics.description: How many times your post was shown on screen. This can include multiple views by the same person. Useful for spotting how often your content gets surfaced.
metrics.name: Impressions

metrics.description: How many times your post was shared by others. A sign your content is reaching beyond your immediate audience.
metrics.name: Shares

metrics.description: How many times people clicked on your post or link. Shows when your content drives action beyond the channel it's on.
metrics.name: Clicks
